description:
A backup software for your Mac or Windows PC.


Improvements
- Added Help > View Cache Statistics..., which shows how much space Arq's local cache uses and why that data is kept, with a button to send the report to Arq Support. "arqc cacheUsage" prints the same report.
- Browsing a very large directory in an Arq 5 backup set is much faster and no longer runs out of memory. The Arq window and ArqMonitor now run as 64-bit processes.
- Improved the performance of collapsing a directory with a very large number of entries in the backup browser.
- Removing unreferenced data after a backup is much faster for large backup sets, and its progress is now written to the activity log.
- Arq now uses Backblaze B2's v4 authorization API, so bucket-restricted application keys created with the current B2 command-line tool or Terraform work. If the key doesn't have access to the configured bucket, Arq says so clearly.
- Google Drive: Arq merges duplicate folders within the storage location's folder.
- The restore activity log now includes the date of the backup record being restored.
- Tightened permissions on the Arq7Agent service's configuration file so that only SYSTEM and Administrators can read it.
Bug Fixes
- Fixed two backup plans with the same UUID (for example after adopting a backup set at a second storage location) interfering with each other's schedules, so that one plan's backup could block or stand in for the other's.
- Fixed Google Drive backups failing repeatedly with "File not found" when a cached file ID was no longer valid. Arq now refreshes the ID and retries.
- Fixed the Arq Premium storage dashboard showing wrong "last updated" dates (or "Unknown") in locales that write the day before the month.
- Fixed a deleted backup plan's status file being left behind.
